description: Trade-date, tenor, contract rate and fixing inputs of an NDF built from its trade date.

base_calendar_id.description: Base-currency holiday calendar id; `None` uses weekends only.

base_currency.description: Restricted (non-deliverable) currency: the numerator and notional currency.

business_day_convention.description: Business-day convention rolling the maturity on the joint calendar.

contract_rate.description: Contract forward rate, base currency per unit of settlement currency.

end_of_month.description: Preserve month-end: a month-end spot date gives a month-end maturity.

fixing_offset_days.description:
Joint business days from fixing to maturity (typically 2); a negative
value places the fixing after maturity's unadjusted date.

settlement_calendar_id.description: Settlement-currency holiday calendar id; `None` uses weekends only.

settlement_currency.description: Convertible settlement currency (typically USD): the denominator.

settlement_days.description: T+N spot lag in business days (typically 2).

tenor.description: Calendar tenor from spot to maturity, e.g. `3M`.

trade_date.description: Trade date from which the spot date is rolled.

title: NdfTradeDateParams
